rows.label: qst620301_msg0001
rows.name:
The Liberalitas Archipelago is a
wonderful place.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0002
rows.name:
I'd heard the rumors, but it feels so
open, nature is abundant, and even the
air tastes good.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0003
rows.name:
I came here with my girlfriend, and it
seems to be a nice change of pace for
her.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0004
rows.name:
Her father is a highly skilled Driver
like you.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0005
rows.name:
But because of that, he is busy and
apparently they hardly ever see each
other.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0006
rows.name:
He is her only family. It can't be
helped, but it is lonely.

rows.label: qst107301_msg0020
rows.name: 納得

rows.label: qst620301_msg0007
rows.name:
So I wanted to ask some highly skilled
Drivers like her father for advice...

rows.label: qst620301_msg0008
rows.name:
I want to propose to her in the
Liberalitas Archipelago. Could you
help me?

rows.label: qst620301_msg0009
rows.name:
All I need is for you to find a nice
gemstone and take me somewhere
romantic.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0010
rows.name: Simple, right?

rows.label: qst107301_msg0025
rows.name: 受注2

rows.label: qst620301_msg0011
rows.name: Oh, thanks so much!

rows.label: qst620301_msg0012
rows.name:
First, I want you to get a gemstone
for the engagement ring.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0013
rows.name:
It is a pure-white gemstone called a
Bouquet Stone.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0014
rows.name:
My acquaintance Mogumogu says it can
only be mined in a certain cave in
Luxuria.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0015
rows.name:
What did he call it...? Pippito's
Lair, I think.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0016
rows.name:
I planned to return to Invidia, save
some money, and have Mogumogu sell me
one, but...

rows.label: qst620301_msg0017
rows.name:
I want to propose now, so I can't help
it.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0018
rows.name:
It may be a little far from here, but
could you get one for me?

rows.label: qst107301_msg0034
rows.name: 了解

rows.label: qst620301_msg0019
rows.name:
This will be a turning point in my
life. I won't skimp on the reward.

rows.label: qst620301_msg0020
rows.name: I'm counting on you!
